records.source_excerpt:
32. In a unitary system of government, pow er is concentrated at the center
A. with devolution B. without residual functions C. without devolution D. with residual functions
records.hold_reason: A unitary state can devolve powers while retaining ultimate central authority. The alternatives incorrectly imply that central constitutional supremacy and devolution are mutually exclusive.
